label: training-internvl-container-process-identity-CPU-v1

diagnostic_terminal: Captured identity/permission rejection may return diagnostic_complete if held cleanup and original terminal accounting close; frontend_ready remains false. UID/runtime transition cause is not inferred without captured values.
transport: Root ordinary existing SSH wrapper owns first-origin120s, local exclusive intent/attempt and held SSH cleanup. build_body performs published-MF and local clean gate. No new connection/service/Slurm wrapper fallback.
